title: Locus Adapter Manifest
description: Catalog of built-in (and future registry) provider adapters. Source TOML: adapters/manifest.toml. Consumed by `locus adapter list` / `locus adapter verify`. Never contains credential values — ids, tools, freeze selectors, and optional detached signatures only.

signature.description: Optional whole-file detached signature (roadmap). Prefer per-provider signatures in v0.

signed_by.description: Key id for the whole-file signature.

synthetic.description: True when tools are in-tree identity stubs (not upstream MCP workers).

frozen_selectors.description: Account/tenant selectors this adapter freezes (project_ref, team_id, orgs, …).

tools.description: MCP tool names owned by this adapter.

destructive_tools.description: Subset of tools marked destructive (policy require_approval hints).

signature.description: Detached signature over canonical entry material. Format: hmac-sha256:<hex> (v0). Future: ed25519:<base64>.

signed_by.description: Trust-store key id that produced signature.
